2034-3000-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3000-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2645-3181-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5670-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-7286.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, South Wind Avatar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2577-3967-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3967-6664-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-3899-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6273-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4770-5870.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2033-3480-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-3480-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-3480-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-6321-6723-6965.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6723-6965.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-6772.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

372-3603-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3603-7487.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4050-7084-7422.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

997-3605-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-3277-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and exiling Ephemerate.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-4050-4775.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

413-1233-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-1233-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
5231-6972-7233.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

296-3532-5078-7010.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
296-3532-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun

722-3153-6913.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

1306-1987-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4417-4567.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.
4417-4567.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

856-2511-4231-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1479-3861-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-6662.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-3231-6488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-3231-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing twice that much damage instead due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Toralf triggers, dealing twice the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Toralf triggers, dealing twice the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-3231-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

1309-1987-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Salvager of Secrets.
When Mnemonic Wall and Salvager of Secrets enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

38-301-4419.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-4419.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.

224-3678-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-3678-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

3259-5223-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5223-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

373-877-2511-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-2511-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

803-1641-2034-4055.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1661-3110-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

618-859-1874-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-1874-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

126-481-2697.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
126-481-2697.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying {R}{R}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Last Chance, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Last Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, Last Chance triggers.
Holding priority, activate Obeka by tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the Last Chance trigger from the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

687-2034-2620-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Safehold Elite dies, triggering its persist ability and Sengir's first ability.
Resolve the Safehold Elite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Safehold Elite.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Safehold Elite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4195.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
2034-3490-4195.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Ich-Tekik triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and each Golem you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the remaining Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1503-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Hansk.
You have a way to give Hansk deathtouch.
Hansk does not have summoning sickness.
1503-2178.description:
Give Hansk deathtouch by any method.
Activate Hansk by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Hansk's deathtouch ability.
Hansk's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.

1893-4404-4659-5261.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Shallow Grave without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Shallow Grave, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

328-1769-1982-2006-2438-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
328-1769-1982-2006-2438-2452.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying {0}.
Sidisi's exploit ability triggers, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Rot Hulk, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Sidisi and Carrion Feeder, if applicable, from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sidisi's exploit ability triggers, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Sedraxis Alchemist, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Cast Sedraxis Alchemist by paying {0}.
Sedraxis Alchemist enters the battlefield, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sedraxis Alchemist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Sidisi and Sedraxis Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sidisi and Sedraxis Alchemist enter the battlefield, triggering Sidisi's exploit ability and Sedraxis Alchemist.
Resolve the Sidisi exploit trigger, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Gray Merchant of Asphodel, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Sedraxis Alchemist trigger, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {0}.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Gray Merchant of Asphodel trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Sedraxis Alchemist trigger, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 19.

411-1812-2510-4893.notablePrerequisites: Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
411-1812-2510-4893.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Prismite for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.

536-1061-1869.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine permanents or have the city's blessing.
536-1061-1869.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you do not have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator triggers, giving you the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
Activate Riptide Laboratory by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the token Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
